ops.title: claude tombstones dead credentials (blank tokens, expiresAt 0, metadata preserved); acct-05 chain was the v0.45.x lock-share bug double-spending the refresh chain; v0.50.1 auto-heals/flag-maps tokenless blobs but panicked on them (fixed v0.50.2)

ops.body:
When claude concludes an OAuth chain is dead it writes a tombstone blob: `accessToken:""`, `refreshToken:""`, `expiresAt:0`, with scopes/subscriptionType/rateLimitTier preserved and no clientId. cc-pool provably never writes this (`validateForWrite` chokepoint).

The 2026-07 acct-05 "UCSF" outage chain (forensics, HIGH confidence): v0.45.0/.1 overlay classify treated claude's `.storage-write.lock`/`.oauth_refresh.lock` as SHARED symlinks → claude's lock release (`rmdir` on a symlink → ENOTDIR) failed every token SAVE fleet-wide from Jul 7 ~15:34 → acct-05's five live sessions rotated the single-use refresh chain in memory without persisting → keychain held a spent refresh token → `invalid_grant` forever → claude tombstoned the blob Jul 8 ~13:00 (persist worked again only because the v0.45.2 lock carve-out fix had deployed). Lock bug fixed v0.45.2 (c065ac89); same defect family as [[carveout-regression-v0363]].

Pre-v0.50.1 the tombstone was INVISIBLE: `parseCredential` returned a plain error, never `ErrNeedsLogin`, so needs_login stayed 0 through 217 failed polls while scoring ranked the dead account #1 ("empty, no usage"). Fixed in v0.50.1 (commit c203997c, shipped inside the TCC commit — see [[jj-working-copy-collision-agent-edits]]): a blob with refreshToken but empty accessToken now parses and force-refreshes on the next poll (auto-heal; `ExpiresWithin` treats empty access token as expiring); a both-empty blob returns `creds.ErrNoTokens` → mapped to `ErrNeedsLogin` only for that sentinel (locked-keychain/not-found blips stay unflagged; flag auto-clears on next good sample). Remedy for a tombstone: `ccp login N` — nothing refreshable remains.
